title: Platform Specification Sheet — Web Hosting Plans Resources by Tier
content:
## Web Hosting Plans: resources each tier provides

Each Web Hosting Plans plan is set up for one primary domain. The resources below apply from the moment the tier takes effect on the plan.

| Resource | Harborline Starter | Harborline Plus | Harborline Pro | Harborline Business | Harborline Cloud 4 | Harborline Cloud 8 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Websites (cPanel add-on domains) allowed | 1 | 10 | 50 | 100 | 300 | 300 |
| NVMe storage, GB | 25 | 50 | 100 | 200 | 200 | 400 |
| Maximum files and folders (inodes) | 200000 | 400000 | 600000 | 1000000 | 2000000 | 3000000 |
| Memory available to the account, GB | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 4 | 8 |
| CPU cores available to the account | 1 | 2 | 2 | 3 | 3 | 6 |
| Concurrent entry processes | 20 | 30 | 40 | 60 | 100 | 150 |
| PHP worker processes | 2 | 4 | 6 | 8 | 12 | 24 |
| MySQL databases allowed | 10 | 50 | 100 | 250 | 500 | 500 |
| cPanel mailboxes included | 5 | 25 | 100 | 250 | 500 | 500 |
| Staging copies allowed | 0 | 1 | 3 | 5 | 10 | 10 |
| SSH access enabled | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Dedicated IPv4 address included | No | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |

### Notes on the sheet

- The websites figure counts the websites (cPanel add-on domains) allowed on the plan.
- Storage is NVMe storage in GB; memory is in GB; the inode figure is the maximum number of files and folders.
- SSH access and the dedicated IPv4 address are either included on a tier or not; no tier offers them partly.

### Example (hypothetical)

A plan whose tier allows 10 websites and 50 GB carries at most 10 websites; an eleventh website is beyond the tier's websites figure.
